newsitem.title: USA: Mazda also in U.S. pact on car lease ads.
newsitem.headline: Mazda also in U.S. pact on car lease ads.

text.p: The Federal Trade Commission said Thursday that Mazda Motor Corp was among five automobile manufacturers to settle with the FTC over charges that they had misrepresented, and made unreadable, lease costs in advertising.
General Motors Corp said earlier Thursday it joined with Honda Motor Co Ltd, Isuzu Motors Ltd and Mitsubishi Motors Corp in reaching a consent agreement with the FTC.

Under the settlement, the FTC said in a statement, the five will be prohibited from featuring low monthly payments or low amounts "down" in large, bold print, while hiding additional costs and sometimes contradictory information in "mouse print" that is difficult or impossible to read.

The FTC said 23 state Attorneys General had entered into similar agreements with General Motors, Mitsubishi, Honda and Isuzu. Fifteen states had filed complaints against Mazda regarding its lease ads.
